While photosynthetic cells (specifically guard cells) regulate the passage of gases, the *main function* of photosynthetic cells is to perform photosynthesis, which is the process of converting light energy into chemical energy (food). Option C accurately describes this primary function. Option D describes a regulatory mechanism (gas exchange) rather than the core metabolic function of the cell itself.
